svg.text: Roshar / niri — Mod+letter/,/./ default keybindings, from files/skel-niri/dms/binds.kdl (DankMaterialShell's vendored defaults). Blank = unbound. Mod = Super on a native niri session (which is how Roshar runs it), so Super+X here is the same key as every other Mod-prefixed bind. Personal tweaks go in ~/.config/niri/local.kdl and aren't shown here — this is only the out-of-the-box default.
